question.prompt: Segment \(AB\) is 10 cm long and makes an angle of \(60^\circ\) with the projection plane. The projection rays are perpendicular to the projection plane. Find the length of the orthographic projection of \(AB\). (Unit: cm)

solutions.explanation: The orthographic projection length is \(AB\times\cos60^\circ=10\times1/2=5\text{ cm}\).
solutions.title: Cosine projection length
